newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK 22 mln 91-day bills at 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK 22 mln 91-day bills at 13 pct.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it raised 22 million kuna through a new issue of 91-day treasury bills at an unchanged rate of 13 percent.
The issue was priced at 96.861 kuna, bottom of the bid range. It is payable in two days and matures on March 20, 1997.
The ministry offered 50 million kuna T-bills, but bids fell way short of the targeted amount. Some 95 percent of the bidders came from the banking sector, it said in a statement.
Croatia will next auction 90 million kuna worth of 42-day bills on January 7. These were issued at 11 percent last week. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
